name: Triarch Stalker
oracle_text:
Targeting Relay — At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose an opponent.
Creatures attacking the last chosen player have menace.
blocked_sentences: Targeting Relay — At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose an opponent.
Creatures attacking the last chosen player have menace.

needs.what: a player choice made by a triggered ability's choose_player (players: opponents) that is remembered on the source permanent and overwritten by each later choice ("the last chosen player"), readable by a static as a player spec -- e.g. a grant_keyword static {keywords: [menace]} whose affects is {types: [Creature], attacking_player: {chosen_player_of: self}}, matching every attacking creature (any controller) attacking that player, and matching nothing before any choice has been made
needs.why_existing_wont_do: choose_player only writes ctx.bindings for the resolving ability, which a static never sees; persistent choices exist only for creature types, colors and card types. A static's attacking_player takes only the words you/opponent/any/most_life (ATTACKING_PLAYER_WORDS) and the loader refuses the {binding} form on a static, so 'opponent' would give menace to creatures attacking every opponent -- a different card in a multiplayer pod
